_about.source: Generation Zero Wiki on Fandom (https://generation-zero.fandom.com), the 'Mission Start' field (start =) of each mission page's MissionInfo infobox, read through the MediaWiki API (action=parse, prop=wikitext); for four stub pages without one (Stalemate, The Response, Normal Lives, Unorthodox Skiing) the start their article text gives.
_about.license: Text from the Fandom wiki, CC BY-SA 3.0 (https://www.fandom.com/licensing). Credit Fandom wherever it is shown.
_about.coordinates: x, y are the numbers Fandom writes next to the start (the in-game map coordinates). They are the same axes and units as our world x, z (map_locations.json / markers.json) with no offset, flip or scale: compared with the map location the start names, they are a median of 39 m and at most 352 m apart over 45 starts (Fandom's figures are rounded readings, e.g. Vesslan Command Bunker 1490, 3885 against 1526.5, 3861.8 in map_locations.json; the Hisingafyren safehouse -5655, 4542 against -5662.8, 4542.4 in markers.json). null = Fandom gives no coordinates.
_about.fields: name = our mission name; place = the start as Fandom names it (null when it names none); location = our map location of that name (exact name, or a spelling difference checked by name and position); note = a short reading of a start that Fandom writes as a sentence; fandom_text = the infobox text (or the article's words, see source) as Fandom has it, markup removed; fandom_title = the page.
_about.matching: Missions matched to Fandom pages by title ignoring case and punctuation (the list on the Missions page and Category:Missions, then the mission name itself); 'Summer Vacation' is the page 'Summer Vaction'; the three Home Base Defense difficulties share 'Our New Home - Home Base Defense'.

622004705.fandom_text: To start the Unorthodox skiing mission you must first travel to the hammarbodarna safe house. From there find the vehicle bench and spawn a bicycle.
